name: earshot
description: Speak short messages on your Android phone through your own Earshot relay, and check whether the phone played them.

mcp_url.title: Relay MCP URL
mcp_url.description: The /mcp URL of your own earshot-relay, for example https://relay.example.com/mcp or http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp.

api_token.title: Relay token
api_token.description: The relay's EARSHOT_RELAY_TOKEN. Stored in your system credential store, never in settings.json.
